title: Ratio: untreated decay, children 5-11 vs children 6-11 untreated cavities
finding: 20% vs 16.7% — the broader 5-11 band shows a higher untreated share than the 6-11 subset, consistent with younger children receiving less routine care.
derived_from: Derived from C02 and C03 (CDC figures as compiled).

title: Childhood caries experience by age 8
finding: 52% of children 6-8 have already had a cavity in baby teeth (C01) — caries experience is majority-prevalent before age 9.

title: Preventable share framing
finding: Two independent prevention measures each show large effect sizes: sealants ~80% fewer back-teeth cavities (C05) and fluoridated water ~25% fewer cavities overall (C06).

title: Adult burden pairing
finding: Lifetime caries experience ~90% (A02) alongside current untreated disease: 25% untreated cavities (A01) and 47.2% gum disease at 30+ (A03).

title: Economic scale pairing
finding: 34 million school hours (C04) and ~$46B productivity (E01) lost annually in the US alone.
